title: New page: /chantix-side-effects for "chantix side effects" (12,100 a month, LOW competition)
body:
URL: /chantix-side-effects
Cluster: chantix side effects
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-16, GSC 2026-10-17..2026-11-13, inventory 2026-11-16

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "chantix side effects" 12,100 (LOW competition, bids up to $16.87), "long term side effects of chantix" 260, "side effects after stopping chantix" 140, "chantix side effects weight loss" 170. Close variants share volume, read as one cluster.
- Inventory: only /quit-smoking-with-varenicline (563 words, modified 2026-10-13) covers the drug, for "varenicline quit smoking". No page targets the side-effect intent. BLO-31 is a refresh of that page for "Chantix to quit smoking", a different intent.
- Fit: people on or about to start Chantix are mid-quit. Medical risk +2, so every claim needs FDA, NHS or MedlinePlus sources.

## Recommended action
Create a side-effects page from FDA label, NHS and MedlinePlus facts only: common effects (nausea, sleep and dreams, headache), rare serious ones and when to call a clinician. No dosing advice and never tell anyone to stop the medication; say "talk to your prescriber". Link to /quit-smoking-with-varenicline, /quit-smoking-medication and /guides/dreams-and-sleep, and back from those pages. Do not claim Blou treats side effects; position the app only for cravings and routine.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Page live with a sourced answer-first box, FAQ from the cluster, links in from 2+ pages; impressions appear for "chantix side effects" within 4 weeks.

title: New page: /popcorn-lung-vaping, what popcorn lung is and what vaping does (about 4,400 a month, LOW competition)
body:
URL: /popcorn-lung-vaping
Cluster: popcorn lung vaping
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-16, GSC 2026-10-17..2026-11-13, inventory 2026-11-16

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "signs of popcorn lung" 4,400, "how to know if you have popcorn lung" 2,400, "will vaping cause popcorn lung" 1,600, "symptoms" 1,000, "what is popcorn lung from vaping" 720 (all LOW competition). Variants overlap, read as one cluster of roughly 4,400.
- Inventory: no page mentions the topic as a target; /vape-withdrawal-symptoms and /quit-vaping-timeline cover withdrawal only. Vaping is a stated priority theme and a confirmed Blou audience.
- Fit: vapers worried about their lungs are a natural bridge to quitting. Medical risk +2.

## Recommended action
Write a neutral, sourced answer (bronchiolitis obliterans, diacetyl, what CDC, NHS and the American Lung Association say, what is and is not established). State the public-health position without recommending e-cigarettes as a quit method. Add "when to see a doctor" and a bridge to /quit-vaping and /tools/lung-recovery. Do not diagnose or promise lungs heal.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Page live, all medical claims cited to CDC/NHS/NIH/peer-reviewed sources, linked from /quit-vaping and /vape-withdrawal-symptoms.

title: New page: /nicotine-gum-side-effects for "nicotine gum side effects" (2,900 a month, LOW competition)
body:
URL: /nicotine-gum-side-effects
Cluster: nicotine gum side effects
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-16, GSC 2026-10-17..2026-11-13, inventory 2026-11-16

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "nicotine gum side effects" 2,900 (LOW), "withdrawal symptoms from nicotine gum" 110.
- Inventory: /nicotine-patch-side-effects exists as the sibling page; /quit-smoking-with-nicotine-gum (617 words) targets "how to use", and is already a refresh in BLO-30. No page matches the side-effect intent.
- Fit: strong, NRT users who hit hiccups, sore jaw or mouth irritation are at risk of quitting the quit.

## Recommended action
Mirror the structure of /nicotine-patch-side-effects. Source from NHS, FDA label and MedlinePlus. Cover hiccups, jaw soreness, mouth irritation, nausea, and the "chew and park" method as a sourced fix. No dosing beyond what NHS states verbatim. Link both ways with /quit-smoking-with-nicotine-gum and /nicotine-patch-vs-gum. Schedule after BLO-30 to avoid overlap.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Page live, linked from the gum page and the patch-side-effects page, no cannibalization with BLO-30 target keywords.

title: New page: /how-long-does-zyn-stay-in-your-system (390 a month) plus "zyn addiction" (480)
body:
URL: /how-long-does-zyn-stay-in-your-system
Cluster: how long does zyn stay in your system
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-16, GSC 2026-10-17..2026-11-13, inventory 2026-11-16

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "how long does zyn stay in your system" 390 (LOW), "zyn addiction" 480 (LOW).
- GSC: the Zyn pages already earn impressions at positions 55 to 75 (/quit-zyn, /zyn-withdrawal), so the domain has Zyn topical signal; no page answers the detection-window question.
- Inventory: /how-long-does-nicotine-stay-in-your-system covers cigarettes/general nicotine (BLO-53 done, suppressed to 2026-12-03). The Zyn-specific window has different half-life and pouch-absorption facts.
- Zyn is topic 2 in the profile.

## Recommended action
Short answer-first page on nicotine and cotinine detection windows for pouch users, with sourced half-life figures, then a section on dependence and a link to /zyn-withdrawal and /quit-zyn. Only cite peer-reviewed or FDA/CDC sources; do not repeat figures from BLO-53 without the same source. Add "zyn addiction" as one H2 only if the page stays one intent.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Page live with sources, links from /quit-zyn, /zyn-withdrawal and /are-zyns-bad-for-you.
